domain_bias: Enforce rigorous orchestration flow across specialist agents, maintain strict pointer-based audit trails via chase.log for all Chases, double up on the Chain of Ruin lens, and mandate Team of Rivals verification before granting final approval.

chase_protocol.definition: A chase represents an inbound goal or prompt list intended to yield verified content.
chase_protocol.logging_mandate: Every prompt dispatched to an agent must be recorded in logs/chase.log alongside a pointer to the generated output artifact or database record.

pipeline_stages.purpose: Capture raw reality of content (text/metadata extraction from URL or raw prompt).
Categorize content and apply neutral philosophical validation + Chain of Ruin forensic lens.
Relate content to manuscript thesis and double-up on Chain of Ruin vectors to produce secondary content feed.
Consume secondary Chain of Ruin feed and synthesize opinion piece / cynical dissection.
Perform multi-perspective forensic verification of Scallywag output prior to Pegleg release decision.

rejection_heuristics.unanchored_claims: Reject any synthesis where claims lack direct pointers to Bronze/Silver knowledge artifacts.
rejection_heuristics.sycophancy_or_softening: Reject outputs that attempt performative cheerfulness, corporate euphemisms, or unevidenced silver linings.
rejection_heuristics.speculative_motives: Reject arguments that attribute unevidenced psychological motives (greed, cowardice) rather than documenting objective knowledge destruction.
rejection_heuristics.structural_fallacies: Reject outputs flagged by Grog for logical incoherence or broken Toulmin warrants.
